objective_and_hypothesis.quote: We further compared African near-complete genome data with global datasets to contextualise representation and identify disparities in sequencing efforts.

public_health_relevance.justification: This matches the score 2 description because the study addresses the substantial burden of non-COVID respiratory infections and surveillance inequities in Africa. It is not an investigation of a specific ongoing outbreak.
public_health_relevance.quote: Mortality rates associated with both non-COVID-19 URI and LRI are highest in sub-Saharan Africa

study_design_rigor.justification: This matches the score 2 description: the design specifies repositories, study viruses, a ≥90% coverage criterion, and MMseqs2 clustering, but important search and curation details are deferred to unavailable supplementary materials and no analysis code is provided in the PDF.
study_design_rigor.quote: All sequences with segment/genome coverage of ≥ 90% underwent nucleotide clustering using MMseqs2[19] with a 95% sequence identity threshold

results_and_conclusion.justification: This matches the score 1 description because a stated summary finding is internally inconsistent with the paper's own Results: page 7 reports IAV (n=10,900) above rhinovirus (n=4,774), but the Discussion reverses their order. The Discussion also cites representative-sequence percentages as Figure 5A and geographical cluster sharing as Figure 5B, whereas the actual figure shows these in panels B and C, respectively.
results_and_conclusion.quote: RSV was the most sequenced non-SARS-CoV-2 respiratory virus in Africa, followed by rhinovirus and IAV.

references.justification: The references provide a strong mix of foundational burden estimates, recent genomic-surveillance research, respiratory-virus epidemiology, data-sharing resources, and methods sources from credible journals. References 37–40 include a relevant institutional webpage and sequence-dataset records rather than peer-reviewed articles, but they are directly relevant; no clearly unrelated reference was identified.
references.quote: Global landscape of SARS-CoV-2 genomic surveillance and data sharing.
